verdict.rationale: Anthropic's transparency hub explicitly links a system card for the current flagship models (Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1), and describes safety-testing across critical risk areas — confirming published system cards exist for the flagship. However, the evidence pack doesn't detail whether the card covers training approach or intended-use sections in depth, and there's no independent corroboration beyond the one first-party mention. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the card includes training methodology and intended-use sections, and independent/hands-on verification of the card's content and currency.
